label: Formulated famous skeptical motto 'Que sais-je?' in the Essais
description: Michel de Montaigne formulated and introduced the concept of "Pyrrhonian Essayistic Skepticism (Que sais-je?)", which became a seminal contribution in epistemology philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in epistemology.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Early Modern & Scientific as part of Michel de Montaigne's canonical writings.

label: Montaigne's radical doubt was the challenge Descartes set out to defeat
description: René Descartes was fundamentally influenced by Michel de Montaigne's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Michel de Montaigne's perspective to René Descartes's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Early Modern & Scientific era.
